label: Block outline
description: Recolours, thickens, fills or removes the outline on the block you are looking at.
settings_description: Settings for the Block outline gameplay mod. It restyles the box vanilla already draws round the targeted block — same block, same shape, same moment — and nothing else; it never outlines a block the game would not, so it says nothing the vanilla outline did not. `kind: gameplay` for `hitboxes`' reason: it is a world mark, not a placeable HUD item.

outline_style.description: What is drawn round the targeted block. `outline` is vanilla's box in your colour; `fill` shades the faces and drops the lines; `both` does both; `none` draws nothing, for players who aim off the crosshair alone.

outline_color.description: Colour of the outline, alpha included. Vanilla's is black at 40%, which disappears against obsidian, coal and every dark wool — the near-white default reads on all of them.

outline_width.description: Line width in screen pixels. Vanilla's is 2.

fill_color.description: Colour of the face shading when `outline_style` is `fill` or `both`, alpha included. Keep the alpha low: a fill is drawn over the block's own texture.
